_doc: Medium batch m12 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

roebuck/f:b0.note: antler thrust is a lance jab: thrust; Rut Rush keeps the pierce thrust too

roebuck/f:b1.note: rut dust is a kicked-up cloud: puff, avoids a second slash

roebuck/f:b2.note: bracken coat is a fern wall: leaf (art beats thorns tag), Bracken Stomp keeps thorn

fisher/f:u1.note: the fisher's own bite: jaws (name beats bash tag); frees bash for Flip Hunt and Barge

fisher/f:u2.note: drops out of the tree canopy: leaf (trip tag would give web); best guess

pangolin/f:b1.note: mound mash is a smash: bash (mash keyword missing from list)

pangolin/f:u3.note: sticky tongue lick on ants: web strands, not an electric quick zig

arctic-fox-kit/f:u2.note: a yip is a sound: ripple rings (trip tag would give web); best guess

whiteout-fox/f:b2.note: drift is snow here, not water: puff (drift keyword gives ripple, not Water class)

whiteout-fox/f:u2.note: snow blindness = glare: sparkle; keeps Brace as the only puff

snow-leopard-cub/f:b2.note: smoky grey coat: smoke puffs, not a plain shield

snow-leopard-cub/f:u2.note: tail swish is a sweeping wave: ripple (trip tag would give web); best guess

snow-leopard-cub/f:b1.note: impatient pounce is a lance leap: thrust; frees a third slash

yak-calf-herd/f:b1.note: herd trample is a heavy stomp: bash

yak-calf-herd/f:u2.note: a bleat is a sound: ripple rings (trip tag would give web); best guess

goat-kid-gang/f:b1.note: headbutt pile is a butt: bash

goat-kid-gang/f:u3.note: springy bouncing kids: sparkle; Ledge Cover keeps the puff

wolverine-cub/f:u1.note: snow tumble kicks up snow: puff; keeps bash to Mauling, Shove

wolverine-cub/f:u3.note: boot scrap is a scrappy scratch: slash; frees a fourth bash

tamandua/f:u2.note: sticky tongue flick: web strands (not the evade puff)

tamandua/f:u3.note: hangs from a branch by its tail, no thorns: leaf
